prompt: Which three actions will you take, starting now, to be more assertive at work?

criteria.label: At least three different actions.
criteria.met: You list three or more different actions.
criteria.missed: List at least three different actions. One action said three ways counts as one.
criteria.unsure: I can't tell whether these are three different actions. Put each on its own line.

criteria.label: Each action is something a colleague could see you do.
criteria.met: A colleague could see you do these.
criteria.missed: Make each action something a colleague could see. "I'll say no to extra tasks when my week is full" is visible. "I'll feel more confident" isn't.
criteria.unsure: I can't tell whether a colleague could see each action. Say what you'll say or do.

criteria.label: At least one action names a time or situation.
criteria.met: You name a time or situation.
criteria.missed: Add a time or situation, like "at Monday's team meeting".
criteria.unsure: I can't tell whether you say when. Name a day, a meeting or a situation.

criteria.label: The actions are yours, not other people's.
criteria.missed: Write what you will do. "My manager should listen more" isn't your action.
criteria.unsure: I can't tell whether these are all your own actions. Start each one with "I will".
